how.title: Three things you do.
how.lede: There is no setup, no dashboard to learn and no plan to choose. From the box above to a shop that can receive a payment is five screens, and you can stop reading this page and just do it.
how.calloutStrong: Nothing is charged, ever, until you make a sale.
how.callout: No trial that quietly starts billing, no card held on file, no plan to cancel.

one.title: Photograph it, or type one line
one.body: Whichever is faster. SolAI reads the photo, works out the category, and never asks you to pick from a list of forty.

two.title: SolAI builds the shop
two.body: Five product shots, a written listing in Kinyarwanda and English, and a price checked against what similar things actually sell for in your city. Change anything you don't like.

three.title: Give us your number
three.body: That's your account and your payout wallet at once. No email, no password, no card. Then your link is live and you can share it.

protection.eyebrow: Why a stranger will buy from you
protection.title: Their money sits with us until you've delivered.
protection.lede: The reason most small sellers stay stuck selling to people they already know is simple: a stranger has no reason to believe a parcel is coming. So we take that decision away from both of you.

paid.title: The buyer pays SolAI, not you
paid.body: A normal MoMo prompt appears on their phone. It says "Amara Beads via SolAI", so nobody is paying an anonymous merchant code and wondering where the money went.

held.title: We hold it — really hold it
held.body: The money sits in our collection account, tracked against the order in a double-entry ledger. It is not yours yet and it is no longer theirs. Both of you can see exactly where it is.

code.title: A four-digit code releases it
code.body: The buyer gets the code by SMS. They read it out to the courier at the door. Nobody is taking anybody's word for anything — the code is the proof, and it only exists on the buyer's phone.

released.title: You're paid in seconds
released.body: Straight to your wallet — typically under ten seconds, not the two to seven days a card platform would take. If the buyer never confirms, it releases to you automatically after 72 hours.

dispute.title: Didn't arrive?
dispute.body: The buyer is refunded. Disputes are answered by a person within 48 hours — that promise is on the product page, not buried in terms.

cash.title: Paying cash?
cash.body: Cash on delivery goes through the same escrow. The courier collects it into the hold — never straight into a pocket.

builtFor.title: Designed around the phone in your hand, not the one in a demo.

momo.title: Mobile money first
momo.body: MTN and Airtel are the default — for buyers paying and for you getting paid. Card exists for the few who want it. No bank account anywhere.

currency.title: Prices in your currency
currency.body: RWF, UGX, KES, TZS. Never a dollar figure you have to convert in your head before you know whether you can afford it.

language.title: In your language
language.body: Kinyarwanda, Swahili, French and English throughout — including the listing SolAI writes and the replies it sends your customers.

signal.title: Works on 3G
signal.body: Tested with data saver on, on an Android under $150. Every screen is built to open on a bad connection, because that's the connection.

pricing.title: You pay us after you've been paid.
pricing.lede: Nobody in this market should be putting card details into a platform that hasn't earned them anything yet. So there's no card at signup, no trial, and no plan decision until after your first payout — and when we do show you a paid plan, we'll tell you if you'd be better off staying free.

lines.cut: Our cut, only when you sell

pricing.footnote: On an RWF 8,500 bracelet that's RWF 255. The mobile-money disbursement fee is shown separately on every order, so you always see the real number before you agree to it.

buyers.title: You're never sending money to a stranger.
buyers.body: You're paying SolAI. We hold it, you get a delivery code that only you have, and the seller is paid the moment you hand that code over. If nothing arrives, you're refunded — and a person answers you inside 48 hours.

bullets.record: Every seller has a visible record — orders delivered, orders confirmed, how fast they ship.
bullets.hold: New sellers are held longer until that record exists. That's the point of it.
bullets.track: Tracked to your door by the courier network, with the code as the handover.

faq.title: The ones people actually ask.
faq.lede: If yours isn't here, message us on WhatsApp — a person replies, usually within the hour.

bank.question: Do I need a bank account?
bank.answer: No. Your mobile money wallet is the payout account, and for most sellers it's the same number they signed up with. If you'd rather use a bank account you can add one, but it settles in one to three days instead of seconds, so almost nobody does.

when.question: When exactly do I get the money?
when.answer: The moment the delivery code is entered at handover — typically under ten seconds later. If the buyer never confirms and never raises a problem, it releases to you automatically 72 hours after delivery. You can see which of those two clocks is running on the order at any time.

lie.question: What if the buyer lies and says it never arrived?
lie.answer: The courier records GPS and a photo at handover, and the code can only come from the buyer's own phone. A dispute is decided on that evidence, not on who complains loudest, and buyers who make repeated false claims are limited the same way fraudulent sellers are.

edit.question: Can I change what SolAI writes about my product?
edit.answer: All of it — the name, the price, the description, which photos to keep. It's a draft, not a decision. Most sellers change the price and leave the rest.

free.question: Is it really free?
free.answer: Yes, and it stays free. We take 3% when you make a sale and nothing when you don't. There is no card at signup and no trial that starts charging. A paid plan exists for sellers doing high volume, and we only mention it once you'd actually save money on it.

holding.question: Who is holding my customers' money?
holding.answer: SolAI, in a mobile money merchant account kept separate from the money the business runs on. Every held amount is tracked against a specific order in a double-entry ledger, reconciled against the account twice a day. Your funds are never used for anything else, and support staff can decide the outcome of a case but can never send money to an account that isn't already on the order.

privacy.title: What we do with your number
privacy.do1: Sign you in — a code to this number, every time. There is no password to steal.
privacy.do2: Send your money — payouts go to the wallet you chose and nowhere else.
privacy.do3: Tell you about orders — an SMS when someone buys, and when money is released.
privacy.dont1: Never shown to buyers. They see your shop name on the payment prompt and the receipt.
privacy.dont2: Never sold or given to advertisers.

storefront.shareFailed: Could not share — copy the link instead
storefront.etaDelivery: Usually delivered same day in Kigali if you order before 4pm.
storefront.etaPickup: Collect from the seller in Nyamirambo. She will message you the address once you order.
storefront.aiNoteTitle: This one is a styled picture
storefront.aiNoteBody: SolAI placed the seller's real item into a setting. Photo 1 is always the actual item, taken by the seller.
storefront.trustTitle: {name} does not get your money yet
storefront.trustBody: You pay SolAI. We hold it, and release it only when you have the bracelet in your hands. If it never arrives, you are refunded.
storefront.newerSellerNote: A newer seller. SolAI holds their money longer until that record grows — which is exactly what makes a first order safe for you.
storefront.recentNote: These are deliveries the buyer confirmed with their own code. They are not written reviews and nobody can post one without having bought.
storefront.shopEscrowNote: Whatever you buy here, your money is held by SolAI until it reaches you. Disputes are answered by a person within 48 hours.
storefront.notifyTitle: Tell me when it is back
storefront.notifyHint: One message when it is available. Nothing else, ever.
storefront.notifyOk: We will message you the moment it is back
storefront.goneLede: It was taken down, or the seller removed it. Nothing has been charged to you and no order was created.
storefront.goneNote: If you already paid for something from this shop, that order is unaffected and still protected. Open the link in your SMS to see it.
storefront.goneCta: See the rest of the shop
storefront.protStep1: You pay SolAI, not {name}. The MoMo prompt says "{name} via SolAI" so you know where it went.
storefront.protStep2: We hold the money. It is not hers and it is no longer yours. Both of you can see where it is.
storefront.protStep3: You get a four-digit code by SMS. You give it at the door, once the parcel is in your hands.
storefront.protStep4: That code is what pays {name}. Nothing else does.
storefront.protWarn: Never give the code before you have the item. Anyone asking for it early — including someone claiming to be from SolAI — is trying to take your money.
storefront.protSla: Nothing arrives? Report it and you are refunded. A person answers within 48 hours.

faq.accountA: No. You need a phone number so we can send you the delivery code and tell you where your order is.
faq.payA: Now, into SolAI's account. Or choose cash on delivery and pay the courier — that goes into the same hold, not straight into the seller's pocket.
faq.wrongQ: What if it is the wrong thing?
faq.wrongA: Report it from your order page. The money is still held while we look, and it is refunded if the seller cannot resolve it.
faq.collectA: Yes — choose that at delivery and there is no fee. You still get a code, and you still give it only when you have the item.
faq.photosA: Photo 1 is always the seller's own photo of the actual item. Anything marked Styled is that item placed into a generated setting.

storefront.reportLede: A person reviews every report. The seller is not told who reported them.
storefront.reportOk: Reported. A person will look at this listing.
storefront.errorLede: Try again in a moment. Your money was not charged.
storefront.notFoundLede: That link does not match a live SolAI shop.
storefront.checkoutStubLede: Your selection is saved. Checkout continues in the next build phase.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.headline: Almost yours
checkout.lede: No account needed. We only need a number, so we can send you the delivery code and tell you where your order is.
checkout.name: Your name
checkout.phoneHint: The delivery code comes here by SMS. This is also how the courier reaches you.
checkout.landmarkPh: Near the market, blue gate opposite the pharmacy
checkout.landmarkHint: A landmark works better than an address here. This is only shown to the courier.
checkout.pickupNote: {name} will message you the exact place and time once you have paid. You still get a code, and you still give it only when the item is in your hands.
checkout.mtnSub: A prompt comes to your phone. Nothing to type in here.
checkout.codSub: Pay the courier. Still protected the same way.
checkout.codBody: The courier collects the cash and it goes into the same hold. The seller is paid after you give the code — never before.
checkout.codHint: Have the exact amount if you can. Couriers rarely carry change.
checkout.cardSub: Visa or Mastercard. Slower to clear.
checkout.cardNote: Card payments take 2–7 days to clear before the seller can be paid. Mobile money is instant, which is why it is first.
checkout.paySolaiNote: You are paying SolAI, not {name}. We release her money only once you confirm the item reached you.
checkout.terms: By paying you agree to the buyer terms. We keep your number to run this order and to tell you about it — nothing else.
checkout.feeNote: SolAI charges the seller, not you. The price you see is the price you pay.
checkout.heldBody: Not delivered? Refunded. A person answers a problem within 48 hours.
checkout.after1: 1 · You get a four-digit code by SMS.
checkout.after2: 2 · {name} packs it and a courier collects.
checkout.after3: 3 · You give the code at the door — only then is she paid.
checkout.errName: The courier needs a name to ask for.
checkout.errPhone: That number looks too short — we send your code here.
checkout.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Nothing was charged.
checkout.promptLede: A payment request has been sent to {phone}. Approve it with your MoMo PIN.
checkout.simNote: The seller's name is in the prompt on purpose. You should never be paying a merchant code you do not recognise.
checkout.dontClose: Do not close this page. It updates on its own.
checkout.resent: Request sent again — check your phone
checkout.cancelChange: Cancel and change how I pay
checkout.promptHelp: No prompt after a minute? Dial your MoMo menu and check pending approvals, or send the request again. Nothing is charged until you enter your PIN.
checkout.failTitle: That payment did not go through
checkout.failLede: Nothing has been taken from your wallet, and your order has not been placed. Nobody is holding your money.
checkout.fail1: The PIN was wrong, or the request timed out.
checkout.fail2: Not enough in the wallet — the total is {total}.
checkout.fail3: The network was busy. This one fixes itself; just try again.
checkout.waHelpText: Hello SolAI, my payment for {product} from {shop} failed.
checkout.failBasket: Your basket is still here. The item is not reserved though — if someone else buys the last one first, we will tell you and refund anything taken.
checkout.codLede: Nothing is charged now. Here is exactly how it will go.
checkout.codStep1: {name} packs it and a courier brings it to you.
checkout.codStep2: You pay the courier {total} and check the item.
checkout.codStep3: The cash goes into SolAI's hold — not into the seller's pocket.
checkout.codStep4: You give your code, and only then is she paid.
checkout.codExact: Bring the exact amount if you can — couriers rarely carry change. If the item is not what was described, do not pay and do not give the code.
checkout.paidLede: Your code is on its way by SMS. Taking you to your order.
checkout.sessionMissingLede: That checkout session is gone. Go back to the product and tap Buy now again.

protected.suspendedBanner: This seller’s shop is paused. Your order and held money are unaffected — we still protect this delivery the same way.
protected.heldLede: {name} can see your order. She cannot see your money — and she will not be paid until you say it reached you.
protected.codeBody: Give it to the courier only once the item is in your hands. That is the moment {name} gets paid.
protected.codeWarn: Nobody should ask you for this code before delivery. Not the seller, not the courier, not anyone saying they are from SolAI. If someone does, report it and do not give it.
protected.moneyWhereBody: In SolAI’s account, against this order. Not {name}’s, and no longer yours. It moves one way or the other — to her when you confirm, or back to you if it never arrives.
protected.cancelNote: You can cancel free until the courier collects it. After that, report a problem instead.
protected.transitLede: Have your code ready. Check the item first, then read the code out.
protected.readOut: Read this out at the door
protected.readOutBody: Only after you have the item and it is what you ordered.
protected.callCourierToast: Calling the courier — your number stays hidden from him
protected.transitNote: If the item is not what was described, do not give the code. Report it instead and the money stays held while a person looks.
protected.alreadyHaveBody: Confirm receipt to release payment. We ask for the last 4 digits of the phone you used at checkout.
protected.nobodyConfirmsBody: If you never confirm and never report a problem, we release to {name} after the delivery window — usually a few days. Report early if something is wrong.
protected.doneLede: Your money was released to {name}. Thanks for shopping protected.
protected.howWasItLede: A quick note helps the next buyer.
protected.rateGood: Thank you — that helps the next buyer
protected.shareFailed: Could not share — copy the link from your browser
protected.disputeLede: Your {total} stays held. {name} is not paid while a person reviews this.
protected.dispute1: A SolAI person reads what you reported.
protected.dispute2: We may message you or {name} on WhatsApp for photos or a short call.
protected.dispute3: Then we release to her, refund you, or ask for one more step — you will hear either way.
protected.addDetail: Add a photo or more detail
protected.refundedLede: {total} has gone back to the wallet you paid from. {name} was never paid.
protected.refundTrace: Nothing arrived after ten minutes? Message us and we will trace it with the network — the reference is on your receipt.
protected.codeSheet1: It exists only on your phone. {name} does not have it. The courier does not have it. We generated it when you paid and sent it to you.
protected.codeSheet2: It is the thing that pays her. Nothing else releases the money — not her saying she shipped it, not the courier saying he delivered it.
protected.codeSheet3: So give it late, never early. Item in hand, checked, then read it out.
protected.codeSheetNote: Lost the SMS? The code is always on this page, and this page is always linked from the message we sent you.
protected.problemLede: Your money stays held while we look. Nothing is released to the seller and nothing is refunded until a person has read this.
protected.problemNote: Reporting is free and it does not cancel your order — if the seller sorts it out, you can close the case yourself.
